correctness.rationale: For every m>=2 with n=2^m and fixed cyclic truth-table coordinate ordering 0..n-1, each nonconstant affine truth table is balanced with n/2 ones, giving cyclic pair weight n/2+T/2. Binary addition transitions occur with frequency 2^(m-t-1) by trailing-ones count plus two all-bit carry transitions. Invertible prefix-parity transformation yields T/2 as subset sum of coefficients {1,1,2,4,...,2^(m-2)}; generating polynomial gives pair enumerator 1+4 sum_{j=1}^{n/2-1} z^(n/2+j)+3 z^n, accounting separately for zero and all-one constants. Selected nonzero low-weight codewords span constant b direction plus exactly the prefix-parity unit axes whose positive coefficient <=j=alpha-n/2. Thus gamma=0 for alpha<=n/2 and 1+min(m,2+floor(log2 j)) above, components 2^(m+1-gamma), connected first at 3n/4 versus Hamming n/2. Fresh independent enumeration of every affine word at m=2..8 checked all coefficients and rank at every integer threshold. Finite checks supplement the all-m proof, not stand in for it.
